import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from scipy.spatial import cKDTree

SAMPLE_FILE = "laterite_composites.csv"
BLOCK_FILE = "laterite_blocks.csv"
OUTPUT_FILE = "limonite_idw_estimates.csv"
DOMAIN = "LIMONITE"
GRADE = "NI_PCT"
TOP_CUT = 2.80
RADII_M = np.array([60.0, 60.0, 15.0])
MIN_SAMPLES = 3
MAX_SAMPLES = 12
POWER = 2.0

samples = pd.read_csv(SAMPLE_FILE)
blocks = pd.read_csv(BLOCK_FILE)
required_samples = {"X", "Y", "Z", GRADE, "DOMAIN"}
required_blocks = {"BLOCK_ID", "X", "Y", "Z", "DOMAIN"}
if not required_samples.issubset(samples.columns):
    raise ValueError(f"Missing sample columns: {required_samples - set(samples.columns)}")
if not required_blocks.issubset(blocks.columns):
    raise ValueError(f"Missing block columns: {required_blocks - set(blocks.columns)}")

samples = samples.loc[samples["DOMAIN"] == DOMAIN].copy()
samples[GRADE] = pd.to_numeric(samples[GRADE], errors="coerce")
samples = samples.dropna(subset=["X", "Y", "Z", GRADE])
samples["NI_PCT_CAPPED"] = samples[GRADE].clip(upper=TOP_CUT)
sample_xyz = samples[["X", "Y", "Z"]].to_numpy(dtype=float)
tree = cKDTree(sample_xyz / RADII_M) if len(sample_xyz) else None

results = []
for _, block in blocks.iterrows():
    result = block.to_dict()
    result["NI_PCT_EST"] = np.nan
    result["N_COMPOSITES"] = 0
    result["MAX_CAPPED_GRADE_USED"] = np.nan
    if block["DOMAIN"] != DOMAIN or tree is None:
        results.append(result)
        continue

    center = block[["X", "Y", "Z"]].to_numpy(dtype=float)
    candidate_idx = tree.query_ball_point(center / RADII_M, r=1.0)
    if not candidate_idx:
        results.append(result)
        continue

    candidate_xyz = sample_xyz[candidate_idx]
    distance = np.linalg.norm((candidate_xyz - center) / RADII_M, axis=1)
    order = np.argsort(distance)[:MAX_SAMPLES]
    chosen_idx = np.asarray(candidate_idx)[order]
    chosen_distance = distance[order]
    if len(chosen_idx) < MIN_SAMPLES:
        results.append(result)
        continue

    capped_grades = samples.iloc[chosen_idx]["NI_PCT_CAPPED"].to_numpy(dtype=float)
    coincident = chosen_distance <= 1e-12
    if coincident.any():
        used_grades = capped_grades[coincident]
        estimate = float(used_grades.mean())
    else:
        used_grades = capped_grades
        weights = 1.0 / np.power(chosen_distance, POWER)
        estimate = float(np.dot(weights, used_grades) / weights.sum())
    result["NI_PCT_EST"] = estimate
    result["N_COMPOSITES"] = len(used_grades)
    result["MAX_CAPPED_GRADE_USED"] = float(used_grades.max())
    results.append(result)

pd.DataFrame(results).to_csv(OUTPUT_FILE, index=False)
estimation_method: Inverse distance weighting (power 2) with a 2.80% Ni top cut
estimation_specification: Estimate nickel grades for LIMONITE-domain blocks by inverse distance weighting with power 2. Read 1 m composites from laterite_composites.csv with columns X, Y, Z, NI_PCT, and DOMAIN, and block centroids from laterite_blocks.csv with columns BLOCK_ID, X, Y, Z, and DOMAIN. Apply a 2.80% Ni top cut to the LIMONITE composites before estimation and exclude all other domains. Search within an axis-aligned ellipsoid with radii of 60 m east-west, 60 m north-south, and 15 m vertically; use the nearest 3 to 12 eligible composites. If coincident composites exist, estimate from their mean capped grade. Write the estimate, informing-composite count, and maximum capped grade used to limonite_idw_estimates.csv. Leave estimates missing when fewer than 3 composites are available.
